scope_note: Static PDF in the Conseil constitutionnel's file store (Last-Modified 10 May 2017, ETag "591336d2-276bf"; embedded CreationDate 10 May 2017). The host answered HTTP 403 to every request for some hours on 26 September 2026 and HTTP 200 to curl's default User-Agent on 27-28 September 2026; no block was bypassed. Issued with the 10 May 2017 proclamation. Its summary table 'Du scrutin à la prise de fonction' (page 8) and the formula entries (pages 11-12) are retrospective: each row is recorded as printed with no structured date and is never a boundary.

visual_review.method: Text layer of all 16 pages searched; pages 1, 8 and 12 rendered and read by the part B researcher; page 11 read from the text layer for this packet.

rows.text: The summary table gives for 1988: second round '8 mai', Council decision '10 et 11 mai', date in the decision 'Le 21 mai à 0 heures', investiture or transfer-of-powers ceremony '21 mai'; the page 11 entry prints 'Cérémonie : 21 mai 1988' above decision no. 88-60 PDR proclaiming Monsieur François Mitterrand.

The same table gives for 1995: second round '7 mai', decision '10, 11 et 12 mai', date in the decision 'Au plus tard le 21 mai à 0 heures', ceremony '17 mai'; the page 11 entry prints 'Cérémonie : 17 mai 1995' above decision no. 95-81 PDR proclaiming M. Jacques Chirac.

The same table gives for 2002: second round '5 mai', decision '6, 7 et 8 mai', date in the decision 'A compter du 17 mai à 0 heures', ceremony '16 mai'; the page 11 entry prints 'Cérémonie : 16 mai 2002' above decision no. 2002-111 PDR of 8 May 2002 proclaiming M. Jacques Chirac 'à compter du 17 mai 2002 à 0 heure'.

The same table gives for 2007: second round '6 mai', decision '7, 8 9 et 10 mai', date in the decision 'Au plus tard le 16 mai à 24 heures', ceremony '16 mai'; the page 12 entry prints 'Cérémonie : 16 mai 2007' above decision no. 2007-141 PDR proclaiming M. Nicolas SARKOZY.

The same table gives for 2012: second round '6 mai', decision '7, 8, 9 et 10 mai', date in the decision 'Au plus tard le 15 mai à 24 heures', ceremony '15 mai'; the page 12 entry prints 'Cérémonie : 15 mai 2012' above decision 2012-154 PDR proclaiming M. François HOLLANDE.

As issued with the proclamation of 10 May 2017, the table's 2017 row has an empty ceremony cell and the page 12 entry prints 'Cérémonie : à venir' above decision 2017-171 PDR proclaiming M. Emmanuel MACRON elected.

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-23 only (Président de la République, 1 January 1990 to the 7 September 2026 cutoff). Election rounds, the Constitutional Council's proclamation, its publication, the investiture ceremony, a stated start of term, an outer limit and any stated end stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Prime ministers, ministers, party offices and the President of the Senate's interim office are excluded.
